name: jstage-mcp
description: J-STAGE (JST): full-text search of Japanese learned-society journals, issue listing and DOI lookup, with typed envelopes and query receipts.
long_description: One of the six bibliograph MCP servers (https://github.com/ckgerteis/bibliograph-mcp). Every search answers with one typed JSON envelope: the term actually sent and its script, how the source matched it, how broad the set is, typed diagnostics, a receipt hash, and the provider's attribution. Receipts can be deposited to an append-only, hash-chained ledger so a search behind a footnote can be named and re-run. Needs no Python of its own: Claude Desktop runs the bundle with uv, which provisions Python 3.13 and the libraries on first launch (a download of roughly 60 MB, cached; later launches take under a second).

receipts_dir.title: Receipts folder
receipts_dir.description: Where this server deposits its append-only, hash-chained query receipts (one <server>.jsonl per server). Leave empty to run without receipts; the envelope will then say RECEIPT_NOT_DEPOSITED.

receipt_session.title: Receipt session slug
receipt_session.description: A project or article slug stamped on every receipt, e.g. my-article-2026. Optional.
